notes.title: Letters to Arralla is OUT!
notes.content: [h1]Heya folks! [/h1][h2]It's finally time.[/h2][h3]Letters to Arralla is [b]OUT NOW[/b]. 🎉🎉🎉🎉[/h3][p]We hope you enjoy your time on the island of Arralla, with all its callipygian (It means "nice butted") residents! With that being said, there are a couple of known issues that we're aiming to get fixed soon post-launch. These include:[/p][list][*][p]Not being able to interact with "E" key prompts on certain keyboard layouts (For now, we suggest using a controller or switching to English when playing to fix this (Sorry! We have a fix we just don't have time to properly test it before launch!🙏))[/p][/*][*][p]Some cutscenes can do weird things when rapidly skipping through them.[/p][/*][*][p]Achievements may not always trigger when they otherwise should be. Some achievements can be unlocked if they didn't trigger correctly by exiting and continuing from a save.[/p][/*][*][p]Sometimes our lovely residents can get stuck behind rocks and other structures when wandering around, don't worry! They're exactly where they want to be (we will perfect their pathfinding in future patches!)[/p][/*][/list][p]We'll be working hard over the coming days to try and resolve the bugs and out of bounds spots y'all will inevitably find, but that's just part of the adventure![/p]

tags.bug: Not being able to interact with "E" key prompts on certain keyboard layouts (For now, we suggest using a controller or switching to English when playing to fix this (Sorry! We have a fix we just don't have time to properly test it before launch!🙏))
Some cutscenes can do weird things when rapidly skipping through them.
Achievements may not always trigger when they otherwise should be. Some achievements can be unlocked if they didn't trigger correctly by exiting and continuing from a save.

Sometimes our lovely residents can get stuck behind rocks and other structures when wandering around, don't worry! They're exactly where they want to be (we will perfect their pathfinding in future patches!)

notes.title: Time for an Updated Demo and Gameplay Trailer for Letters to Arralla!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello folks, it's Next Fest time![/h2][p][/p][p]We at Little Pink Clouds are thrilled to be able to participate in this week's Next Fest, and what a week it's been already! We had our game trailer showcased in Wholesome Direct [i]and[/i] Frosty Games Fest over the weekend, and the reception so far has been beyond our wildest expectations. Some of my favourite social media comments I've seen on our trailers include: "[i]Ayo why's he caked up like that[/i]", and, "[i]The best time you can have delivering the post with your whole arse out[/i]".[/p][p]I'm proud and awed in equal measure that we're able to help deliver this caked-up mail-turnip experience for all to enjoy.[/p][p]For [i]your[/i] enjoyment, we have an extended cut of the showcase trailer from Frosty Games Fest, which is roughly 40 seconds longer than the showcase version. More frames! More cake![/p][previewyoutube="4gRTzNuE4OE;full"][/previewyoutube][p]But it hasn't all been making trailers and taking funny screenshots in Little Pink Cloud's home offices. It's been exactly 9 months since the demo for Letters to Arralla first launched on Steam. Since then, we have been hard at work to make it the best caked-up mail-turnip adventure we can! To that end, we have updated our demo for Letters to Arralla, showcasing many of the new improvements and features added to the game since September last year.  Some of those features include:[/p][list][*][p]More mail-based puzzles! 📨📬[/p][/*][*][p]New characters! 🫒🥬[/p][/*][*][p]More island to explore! 🏝️🏝️🏝️[/p][/*][*][p]More Story! 📕📖[/p][/*][*][p]More collectibles! 🌺🌼[/p][/*][*][p]The suburbs and more beach! 🏡🏖️🏡[/p][/*][*][p]Wearable hats! 👒🧢[/p][/*][*][p]Sitting! 🪑🪑[/p][/*][*][p]More vibes! 🌊🌴🏖️🐚[/p][/*][/list][p]We're not quite finished yet, but we're getting closer to where we want Letters to Arralla to be. For now though, we hope that you enjoy our latest little taste of what's to come on Arralla Island!

Happy Next Fest![/p]
